intro: Turn your bedroom into a calm, clutter-free retreat. The Elys bed combines spacious comfort, a handy headboard ledge, and smooth drawer storage to keep your nights restful and your days organized.

features.title: Minimal, modern design
features.text: Elys blends simplicity with elegance, featuring clean lines and a refined brown finish that fits seamlessly into today’s homes.

features.title: Storage made effortless
features.text: Built-in drawer storage slides smoothly, giving you easy access to blankets, bedding, or daily essentials without lifting heavy panels.

features.title: Headboard ledge for display and utility
features.text: The thoughtful headboard ledge holds your phone, books, or décor accents, helping you keep everything within reach and your space stylish.

features.title: Durable engineered wood build
features.text: Crafted with 15mm PLT engineered wood, the bed offers reliable support and strength for daily use while staying low on maintenance.

features.title: Easy knockdown assembly
features.text: The knockdown construction makes it simple to set up or shift, giving you flexibility to adapt your bedroom with ease.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
